title: Nemotron-Cascade 2: Post-Training LLMs with Cascade RL and Multi-Domain On-Policy Distillation

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: How might post-training models like Nemotron-Cascade 2 reshape our expectations of AI's real-world impact?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Cascade RL and multi-domain distillation enable fine-tuned, domain-specific agents with unprecedented reasoning and autonomy.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: But with such power comes risk — could these models be exploited for misinformation or manipulative behavior at scale?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Builders are embedding guardrails and using aligned reward models to ensure safe deployment across domains.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Imagine a future where AI agents collaborate with humans in healthcare, law, and education, transparent and accountable.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future of AI lies in balancing innovation with ethical stewardship — a challenge we must tackle together.
